summary: Implementation satisfies the saved Alembic target-branch resolver plan. The resolver has deterministic single-head no-op and multi-head merge behavior, refuses malformed or unsafe graphs with structured reason codes and no mutation, target-branch reconciliation gates staging/commit/push through dry-run and commit-policy results, and operator-facing result, log, and workspace event payloads preserve resolver details, commit SHA, pushed state, changed paths, dry-run state, and policy decisions. Required validation passed: ruff, mypy, planned Alembic/integration pytest surface, and full unit suite.
